risks.title: Increased competitive intensity in Spain and key markets
risks.score_rationale: Explicit reference to 'Competition in Spain' (Section 9, p.979) in Item 1A. Moderate language but central strategic positioning. Stable but structural trend. High weight: core of the geographic diversification model.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risk and cyberattacks
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity explicitly mentioned in Item 16.K (p.1016) and Item 5.E (p.509). Alert language: 'cyberattacks, data breaches, data losses' in forward-looking statements. Upward trend: dedicated section in Risk management (Section 5, p.582). Critical weight: central digital infrastructure.

risks.title: Dependence on banking regulation and capital requirements
risks.score_rationale: Supervision and regulation (Section 10, p.981) and Capital risk (Section 4, p.580) explicitly addressed. Strong language: 'regulatory capital and liquidity requirements' and 'greater regulation prompted by financial crises'. Stable trend but high structural weight for the sector.

risks.title: Credit risk and deterioration in portfolio quality
risks.score_rationale: Credit risk section (Section 2, p.556) detailed. Forward-looking statements mention 'potential losses from early loan repayment, collateral depreciation or counterparty risk'. Upward trend: sensitivity to economic cycles. Major weight: core of banking activity.

risks.title: Political and geopolitical instability in operating regions
risks.score_rationale: Forward-looking statements explicitly cite 'political instability in Spain, the US, the UK, other European countries and Latin America' and 'war in Ukraine, uncertainties following the ceasefire agreement in the Middle East'. Upward trend. High weight: multi-geographic presence.

risks.title: Technological transformation and dependence on IT systems
risks.score_rationale: Section 7 'Technological innovation: artificial intelligence, cybersecurity and fintech ecosystem' (p.509) dedicated. Language of importance: 'digital bank with branches' and 'global platforms'. Upward trend: AI and fintech accelerating. Strategic weight: business model transformation.

risks.title: Reputational risk and loss of stakeholder trust
risks.score_rationale: Forward-looking statements mention 'reputational risk and potential adverse reactions of stakeholders, including adverse effects on the market price of our securities'. Stable trend but high sensitivity. Major weight: highly reputational financial sector.

risks.title: Compliance risk and money laundering
risks.score_rationale: Compliance risk (Section 6, p.588) has a dedicated section. Implicit alert language: 'Business conduct' (Governance information, p.93). Upward trend: strengthening of AML/KYC standards. High weight: highly scrutinized sector.
